name: Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Job Hunter

parameters.content:
## Setup Required
1. Create Google Sheet named **Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Jobs** with 4 sheets: Raw Jobs, Filtered Jobs, Applied, Rejected
2. Replace **REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID** in all Google Sheets nodes with your actual Sheet ID
3. Add credentials: Google Sheets OAuth2, Gmail OAuth2, OpenAI API
4. Replace **REPLACE_WITH_CREDENTIAL_ID** in credential blocks
5. Set your Gmail address in the Send Gmail Digest node

**Sheet columns:**
- Raw Jobs: date_found, source, job_title, company, job_url, location_text, salary, description, posted_date, tags, job_id
- Filtered Jobs: date_found, score, job_title, company, job_url, salary, taiwan_eligible, taiwan_reason, location_risk, timezone_risk, contractor_possible, async_level, role_category, why_good_fit, decision, application_status, notes
- Applied: date_applied, job_title, company, job_url, cover_letter_used, status, follow_up_date, notes
- Rejected: date_rejected, job_title, company, job_url, reason

parameters.jsCode:
const rejectPatterns = [
  /\bus[\s-]only\b/i,
  /\bcanada[\s-]only\b/i,
  /\buk[\s-]only\b/i,
  /\beu[\s-]only\b/i,
  /\beurope[\s-]only\b/i,
  /\baustralia[\s-]only\b/i,
  /must be based in/i,
  /must live in/i,
  /must be authorized to work in/i,
  /local work permit required/i,
  /requires.*work.*permit/i,
  /authorized to work in/i,
  /\bhybrid\b/i,
  /\bonsite\b/i,
  /\bon-site\b/i,
  /office required/i,
  /in-person required/i,
  /remote within.*only/i,
  /fixed us hours/i,
  /fixed eu hours/i,
  /us residents only/i,
  /uk residents only/i,
  /must reside in/i,
  /legally authorized.*united states/i,
  /\bh1b\b/i,
  /employment authorization/i
];

return $input.all().filter(item => {
  const text = `${item.json.description} ${item.json.location_text} ${item.json.tags}`.toLowerCase();
  const rejected = rejectPatterns.some(p => p.test(text));
  if (rejected) return false;
  return true;
});

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
  "response_format": { "type": "json_object" },
  "max_tokens": 400,
  "temperature": 0.1,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

The most important rule: Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

Do not pass the job only because it says 'remote'.

Reject the job if it requires the worker to live in the US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan.
Reject the job if it requires local work authorization outside Taiwan.
Reject the job if it is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only.
Reject the job if it requires fixed working hours that would force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan (Taiwan is UTC+8).

Keep the job only if one of these is true:
- The job says worldwide remote.
- The job says work from anywhere.
- The job says global remote.
- The job says APAC remote.
- The job allows international contractors.
- The job accepts people based anywhere.
- The company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement.

Return JSON only: { "taiwan_eligible": "yes/no/unclear", "reason": "short reason", "location_risk": "low/medium/high", "timezone_risk": "low/medium/high", "contractor_possible": "yes/no/unclear", "decision": "keep/reject/manual_check" }"
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": {{ JSON.stringify('Job Title: ' + ($json.job_title || '') + '
Company: ' + ($json.company || '') + '
Location: ' + ($json.location_text || '') + '
Description: ' + ($json.description || '').substring(0, 1500)) }}
    }
  ]
}
